# Sales Qualification Agent — Production Runbook

> **Scenario**: Sales Qualification Agent
> **Platform**: Microsoft Copilot Studio — GitHub Copilot harness
> **Target readers**: Makers, delivery engineers, customer or partner operators

**Estimated effort**: Not yet measured; record actual effort on the Frontier Clock.

**Template:** an example to modify for your requirements; the customer or partner wires it into their environment. See the [Overview](1.Overview.md).

## Prerequisites

| Requirement | Details | Owner |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Build workload | 22 captured build checkpoints; 6 skills; 2 knowledge files; 6 acceptance checks; 6 locked cases. [Inventory](2.Architecture.md#copilot-studio-components), [checks](0.Resources/README.md#template-acceptance-checks), and [cases](4.Sample-prompts.md#demo-prompts). | Template |
| Licensing and capacity | Confirm tenant licensing and Copilot Credits for the GitHub Copilot harness; building, Preview and evaluation consume credits before publication. | Customer or partner |
| Environment and maker access | Record the approved sales environment, publisher prefix and maker access. Confirm the reviewed Sonnet46 model is available; keep the workshop synthetic and Draft. | Customer or partner |
| DLP and data policy | Have the administrator review uploaded lead documents, the proposed CRM, enrichment, territory and Teams connections and the channel; document blocked paths, never bypass them. | Customer or partner |
| Identity and audience | Review the supplied GroupMembership access policy, Integrated authentication and Always authentication trigger; record who may build, test and later use the agent. | Customer or partner |
| Connection ownership | Name owners for the lead, enrichment, territory and capacity, and review connections with dedicated references. No customer connection is needed for the synthetic workshop. | Customer or partner |
| Test identities | Prepare sales manager, business development, account executive and denied-access identities for an approved test deployment; makers use Draft Preview. | Customer or partner |
| Tooling by build lane | Manual lane: Copilot Studio in the browser and the reviewed files. Easy mode: VS Code Agent mode, the Microsoft Copilot Studio plugin and PAC CLI 2.9.3 or newer. | Customer or partner |
| Qualification policy ownership | Have sales operations own the ICP weights, tiers, routing and SLA rules that replace the synthetic ones, and have privacy review contact data use. | Customer or partner |

## Phase 0 — Qualify and Adapt the Template

### Step 0-1. Qualify the outcome and baseline

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Sales business owner

Complete the [qualification checklist](1.Overview.md#qualification-checklist).

**Measure:** Lead volume, qualification consistency and routing follow-up as handled manually today. Show where inconsistent qualification and uneven routing create follow-up risk before agreeing success measures.

Fill your baseline record:

| Lead source | Measurement period | Lead volume | Qualification criteria used | Routing method | Missed follow-ups | Review owner |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |

Agree qualification replacement connections, governance, telemetry, support and success measures before production.

### Step 0-2. Adapt scope and name owners

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Sales business owner

Adapt [scope](1.Overview.md#in-scope--out-of-scope) and the [data contract](2.Architecture.md#data-contract); assign approval roles.

| Role | Responsibility |
| --- | --- |
| Sales business owner | Approve lead sources, audience and success measures; keep synthetic scores, tiers and conversion assumptions out of customer results. |
| Authorized sales manager and reviewers | Approve qualification, routing, ownership, SLA rules, escalation, outreach content and customer contact, with marketing, privacy, legal and sales-operations review. |
| Copilot Studio maker | Build the reviewed instructions, two knowledge files and six skills; remove web search, confirm the model and keep the owned agent in Draft. |
| Power Platform administrator | Confirm licensing, capacity, maker access, authenticated audience and data policies before approving any sales connection. |
| Sales data and connection owners | Approve Dynamics 365 Sales, enrichment, territory and capacity, and Teams connections with dedicated references; own access failures. |
| Acceptance reviewer | Check SQ-01 through SQ-06, the boundary tests and Easy/Manual parity; reject forbidden side-effect wording and reshoot-required captures. |
| Operations owner | Own production support, session and credit monitoring and configuration recovery; route qualification decisions to sales managers. |

### Exit criteria

- [ ] Qualification replacement connections, governance, telemetry, support and success measures have named agreement.
- [ ] The sales owner records lead volume, qualification consistency and routing follow-up gaps before choosing success measures.

## Phase 1 — Environment, Identity and Access

### Step 1-1. Approve the identity and settings design

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Power Platform administrator

Review and approve the [identity design](2.Architecture.md#identity-and-permissions) and [template settings](../../solutions/sales-qualification/copilot-studio/settings.mcs.yml). Apply agent-specific settings when the agent is built in [Phase 2](#phase-2--build-and-prove-the-agent).

Approve document, connector and channel policies; require authentication and verify blocked routes stay blocked.

### Step 1-2. Configure tenant controls

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Power Platform administrator

Approve the environment, audience and connection identities. Define the [authentication plan](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/configuration-end-user-authentication); configure environment [data policies](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/admin-data-loss-prevention).

### Exit criteria

- [ ] The administrator's data policies cover the proposed CRM, enrichment, territory and Teams connectors, knowledge sources and intended channel; blocked routes stay blocked.
- [ ] The customer confirms authenticated audience and least-privilege access for lead and contact data.

## Phase 2 — Build and Prove the Agent

### Step 2-1. Choose the build lane

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Copilot Studio maker

| Lane | Suits | Output |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Easy mode with GitHub Copilot (default) | Assisted authoring | Synthetic Draft proof |
| Manual build in Copilot Studio | Browser-only makers | Same Draft proof |
| AIBAST Frontier (experimental) | Portable learning | Behavior proof; native validation follows |

[Compare lanes](1.Overview.md#delivery-lanes); local Brainstem remains optional.

### Step 2-2. Build the selected implementation

**Owner:** Template · **Role:** Copilot Studio maker

**Easy mode:** use the [authoring skill](../../skills/aibast-easy-mode-copilot/SKILL.md) and [reviewed messages](../../solutions/sales-qualification/EASY-MODE-COPILOT-CHAT.md). **Manual:** use the [single inventory](2.Architecture.md#copilot-studio-components) and [tutorial](https://microsoft.github.io/aibast-agents-library/solutions/sales-qualification/manual-tutorial.html) with the checklist below. **Portable learning:** follow [deployment.json](../../solutions/sales-qualification/deployment.json); it does not replace native Draft validation.

**Manual build checklist** — [captured sequence](../../solutions/sales-qualification/screenshots/manual/browserfilm.json). Record current results.

1. Create a blank Copilot Studio agent
2. Name Sales Qualification Manual
3. Enter the reviewed global instructions
4. Save the instruction policy
5. Remove default web search
6. Add knowledge: aibast_sales-qualification-operating-rules.md
7. Add knowledge: aibast_sales-qualification-synthetic-records.md
8. Add skill: assign-leads
9. Add skill: bant-analysis
10. Add skill: create-outreach
11. Add skill: qualification-report
12. Add skill: score-leads
13. Add skill: setup-tracking
14. Review model, skills, knowledge, and safety boundaries
15. Open a fresh Preview conversation
16. Pass SQ-01: Sales Manager
17. Pass SQ-02: Business Development Rep.
18. Pass SQ-03: Business Development Rep.
19. Pass SQ-04: Sales Manager
20. Pass SQ-05: Sales Manager
21. Pass SQ-06: Account Executive
22. Confirm Draft and stop before publish

### Step 2-3. Enforce workshop integrity

**Owner:** Template · **Role:** Acceptance reviewer

Apply the [workshop integrity and recovery rules](2.Architecture.md#state-and-recovery) before replay.

### Step 2-4. Replay the synthetic proof

**Owner:** Template · **Role:** Acceptance reviewer

**Synthetic demo acceptance:** record every locked case: SQ-01, SQ-02, SQ-03, SQ-04, SQ-05, SQ-06. Use the [acceptance matrix](4.Sample-prompts.md#per-case-acceptance-matrix) and [template acceptance checks](0.Resources/README.md#template-acceptance-checks).

### Exit criteria

- [ ] This lane's Preview evidence identifies the agent, environment, model, inventory, cases and Draft state.
- [ ] If this lane is chosen, the recipe smoke test calls `SalesQualificationAgent` and returns `Lead Qualification Summary` and `Evidence boundary`.
- [ ] The manual build has reviewed instructions, two knowledge files, six skills and the confirmed model; web search and tools are absent.
- [ ] Each unchanged SQ prompt passes once in a separate fresh Preview conversation on the owned Draft.
- [ ] The deterministic validator judges every case on its final response; annotated screenshots are checkpoints, not the machine gate.
- [ ] Any Easy/Manual comparison uses identical instructions, knowledge, skills, model and case identifiers.

## Phase 3 — Wire In Your Systems

<a id="shared-integration-controls"></a>

**Shared identity and scope controls**

For each integration, decide end-user versus approved maker/service credentials. [Configure authentication](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/configuration-end-user-authentication) for the [authorized audience](2.Architecture.md#identity-and-permissions).

**Shared scope:** Require sign-in before exposing lead, contact or seller data. Request only the scopes needed for approved lead, enrichment and territory sources. Restrict the audience and test authorized and denied identities. Enforce these restrictions at each connection.

### Step 3-1. Integrate Dynamics 365 Sales

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Sales data and connection owners

1. **Bind Dynamics 365 Sales — read:** Add approved read-only lead actions; any owner change stays a manager-approved write.

2. **Identity for Dynamics 365 Sales:** Follow the [shared controls](#shared-integration-controls); record the credential choice.

3. **Scope Dynamics 365 Sales:** Apply the [shared restrictions](#shared-integration-controls); document system-specific limits.

4. **Exit test for Dynamics 365 Sales:** Record expected and actual results on approved fixtures. [Boundary case 2](4.Sample-prompts.md#routing-and-boundary-cases): Assign no owner and update no CRM record; recommend routing for manager approval. [Recovery](2.Architecture.md#state-and-recovery): Name the missing field; never invent or substitute a value.

### Step 3-2. Integrate Approved lead-enrichment connector

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Sales data and connection owners

1. **Bind Approved lead-enrichment connector — read:** Bind only the approved connector, read-only, after privacy review.

2. **Identity for Approved lead-enrichment connector:** Follow the [shared controls](#shared-integration-controls); record the credential choice.

3. **Scope Approved lead-enrichment connector:** Apply the [shared restrictions](#shared-integration-controls); document system-specific limits.

4. **Exit test for Approved lead-enrichment connector:** Record expected and actual results on approved fixtures. [Boundary case 4](4.Sample-prompts.md#routing-and-boundary-cases): Do not browse, search social profiles or call enrichment services; score only the bundled snapshot. [Recovery](2.Architecture.md#state-and-recovery): Report unavailable evidence; never claim a lookup, assignment, message or CRM update succeeded.

### Step 3-3. Integrate Territory and capacity data

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Sales data and connection owners

1. **Bind Territory and capacity data — read:** Map the approved territory and capacity source read-only as knowledge or a connector action.

2. **Identity for Territory and capacity data:** Follow the [shared controls](#shared-integration-controls); record the credential choice.

3. **Scope Territory and capacity data:** Apply the [shared restrictions](#shared-integration-controls); document system-specific limits.

4. **Exit test for Territory and capacity data:** Record expected and actual results on approved fixtures. [Boundary case 2](4.Sample-prompts.md#routing-and-boundary-cases): Assign no owner and update no CRM record; recommend routing for manager approval. [Recovery](2.Architecture.md#state-and-recovery): Report unavailable evidence; never claim a lookup, assignment, message or CRM update succeeded.

### Step 3-4. Integrate Microsoft Teams

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Sales data and connection owners

1. **Bind Microsoft Teams — write:** Keep plans as drafts; gate any Teams post or alert behind manager approval (preview).

2. **Identity for Microsoft Teams:** Follow the [shared controls](#shared-integration-controls); record the credential choice.

3. **Scope Microsoft Teams:** Apply the [shared restrictions](#shared-integration-controls); document system-specific limits.

4. **Exit test for Microsoft Teams:** Record expected and actual results on approved fixtures. [Boundary case 3](4.Sample-prompts.md#routing-and-boundary-cases): Activate no alert or automation; return a draft SLA plan for manager approval. [Recovery](2.Architecture.md#state-and-recovery): Report unavailable evidence; never claim a lookup, assignment, message or CRM update succeeded.

### Step 3-5. Connect

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Sales data and connection owners

Create dedicated connection references for the approved seams; do not reuse ambiguous existing connections.

### Exit criteria

- [ ] Approved sources preserve grounding and citation boundaries; tools replace skill seams only after identity, authorization, confirmation and success evidence are defined.
- [ ] No CRM write, outreach, task, alert or customer communication occurs from the agent.

## Phase 4 — Evaluate on Your Data

### Step 4-1. Adapt the evaluation corpus

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Acceptance reviewer

Preserve [locked behaviors](4.Sample-prompts.md#per-case-acceptance-matrix) and [boundary tests](4.Sample-prompts.md#routing-and-boundary-cases) when substituting approved customer fixtures.

### Step 4-2. Set thresholds and evaluate your data

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Acceptance reviewer

Have the business owner approve thresholds. Run [adapted evaluations (preview)](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/agents-experience/analytics-agent-evaluation-intro) before publication under approved test user profiles. Keep exact assertions separate from General quality scores.

Test an approved deployment as intended sellers and an unshared identity; a maker's access does not prove user access.

### Exit criteria

- [ ] The business owner sets customer-data acceptance measures; synthetic scores, tiers and conversion assumptions are not thresholds.
- [ ] Adapted evaluations record the tested version and user profile; General quality scoring does not replace exact assertions.

## Phase 5 — Pilot and Rollout

### Step 5-1. Review the template release prerequisites

**Owner:** Template · **Role:** Acceptance reviewer

These synthetic regression gates do not set production thresholds. The reference workshop stays Draft; production approval belongs to the customer pilot.

| Template gate | Required evidence |
| --- | --- |
| Locked qualification corpus | All six cases, SQ-01 through SQ-06, include every required anchor and none of the forbidden wording. |
| Manual inventory | Two knowledge files, six skills and the reviewed model; no tools or web search. |
| Sales authority boundary | Any sent outreach, owner assignment, CRM update, alert, sequence or conversion claim is no-go. |
| Approval gate in every answer | Each response names the sales-manager review and states that no CRM, assignment, outreach or customer action occurred. |
| Visual checkpoint acceptance | Require a visible positive anchor without a blocker or refusal; withhold reshoot-required captures. |
| Release state | The owned workshop agent is Draft with `published: false`. |

### Step 5-2. Publish and share deliberately

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Sales business owner

With business approval, [publish and share](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/agents-experience/authoring-share-agent) the adapted build with a restricted test audience. Keep the reference workshop Draft.

Require explicit confirmation before the production publish operation.

### Step 5-3. Run the governed pilot

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Sales business owner

**Pilot entry gate:** Test allowed and denied identities on the published, shared agent; resolve access failures before admitting pilot users. Compare pilot results with the baseline and thresholds; broaden rollout only after go/no-go.

### Exit criteria

- [ ] The production publish operation has explicit human confirmation.
- [ ] The approved sales audience and supported channels are tested before publication is confirmed.

## Phase 6 — Operate

### Step 6-1. Retain the operational playbook

**Owner:** Template · **Role:** Operations owner

The template provides the [state-and-recovery playbook](2.Architecture.md#state-and-recovery) and regression cases.

### Step 6-2. Own changes and ongoing verification

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Operations owner

Review content freshness and permissions; re-evaluate source, model, skill or connector changes. [Monitor the deployed agent](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/agents-experience/analytics-overview).

Review failed qualification sessions, side-effect claims, connection errors and credit consumption in Monitor.

### Step 6-3. Release: ALM

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Copilot Studio maker

Back up the reviewed workspace, pull before editing and pushing, then package with `pac copilot pack`.

### Step 6-4. Release: recovery

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Power Platform administrator

Confirm backup eligibility for the environment type and rehearse restoration to a supported test target.

### Exit criteria

- [ ] The recovery rehearsal uses a restore path supported for the environment type and target.
- [ ] The operator reviews failed sessions, source usage, connection errors and credit consumption after rollout.

### Customer or partner delivers
